title: Blank cells outside the stored word
statement: Let $w$ be a finite Boolean word and $z$ an integer. If $z$ is not a nonnegative integer strictly less than the length of $w$, then the buffer tape storing $w$ is blank at cell $z$.
hypotheses_covered: It is not the case that $0\le z<|w|$
